commentary.text: 90+8' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' 4 - 2 Ayden Heaven plays a neat ball into the path of Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United), who makes room for a shot and sends it towards the top right corner, ricocheting in off the post! 4:2.

90+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Bart Verbruggen is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90+5' The game is interrupted. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+4' The foul by Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.

90+2' 3 - 2 James Milner takes over corner duties and expertly finds Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the left side of the goal. The score is now 3:2.
90+2' The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
90+2' Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

88' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the left side of the goal, but Senne Lammens is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Good work from Brighton as they win a corner.
87' Mats Wieffer goes off the pitch and Stefanos Tzimas (Brighton) comes on.
87' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
86' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Anthony Taylor who sees an offensive foul.
84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Sesko departs the field of play to be replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
81' Ruben Amorim decides to make a substitution. Matheus Cunha will be replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
81' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
79' A substitution has been made. Georginio Rutter goes off and Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) comes on.
78' Excellent touch by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.

76' Diego Gomez (Brighton) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

75' Tom Watson (Brighton) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Senne Lammens was alert and the score remained the same.
74' 3 - 1 Danny Welbeck (Brighton) displays his brilliant free kick ability. The ball flies towards the goal and ends under the crossbar. What a finish!
74' Relief for Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.

73' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United), but referee Anthony Taylor must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
72' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
71' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

71' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a spectacular save to deflect it onto the post. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
70' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Casemiro and he is replaced by Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United).
70' Substitution. Amad Diallo is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
69' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
67' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Danny Welbeck (Brighton).
65' None of the Brighton players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
65' Today's match ends for Luke Shaw who will be replaced by Ayden Heaven (Manchester United).

64' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Brighton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

61' 3 - 0 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) neatly controls a decent pass from Benjamin Sesko. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. 3:0.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Diego Gomez (Brighton) is replacing Yasin Ayari.
59' Here is a change. Maxim De Cuyper is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Tom Watson (Brighton).
59' The manager makes a subsitution with James Milner (Brighton) coming on for Carlos Baleba.
56' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Bart Verbruggen.
54' The current number of shots on goal is 4:1.
51' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
51' Anthony Taylor blows the whistle, Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul.
50' The linesman raises his flag. Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.

48' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Bart Verbruggen is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
47' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
46' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Referee Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' It's a weak and poor shot by Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) as he flashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies well wide of the right post.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
43' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:3.
41' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
38' A rebound falls at the feet of Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
38' The corner finds Lewis Dunk (Brighton) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post.
38' The ball goes out of play and Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
35' Flag goes up against Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
34' 2 - 0 Goal! Luke Shaw passes the ball to Casemiro (Manchester United) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Bart Verbruggen couldn't do anything about it. 2:0.
31' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton).
30' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
28' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
26' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
24' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Casemiro provided an assist for the goal.
22' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
21' A corner kick by Brighton is thwarted by the well prepared Senne Lammens (Manchester United).
20' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Brighton will have an opportunity.
19' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Danny Welbeck (Brighton) and blew his whistle.

17' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
16' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
15' Senne Lammens was forced into action to thwart Danny Welbeck (Brighton). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
14' The possession of the ball – 43:57.
10' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
10' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
9' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
7' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
6' Manchester Utd keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
4' A sweet pass inside the box gives Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor was nominated as the referee for this game.
